subject: POC kickoff - setup, checklist, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechcorp.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:15:15 -0700
Subject: Fintech Corp — POC discovery recap & proposed kickoff

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about the fraud detection workflow you run across authorization and chargeback windows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your POC started smoothly: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood reduces per-request latency and lowers per-token cost vs current provider for your modeled inference workload (inference for realtime scoring + nightly batch rerank).
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency <= 120ms at 50 qps and cost per 1M tokens < $X (we'll align numbers once we see traces).
- POC scope: 1) hosted sandbox API with dedicated model variant; 2) sample prompts & eval set; 3) one week of pilot traffic with telemetry.

Action items / proposed timeline:
1) Kickoff call (30m) to do a live walkthrough of the sandbox and map your integration points — propose Tue, Jul 7 or Wed, Jul 8 (your preference).
2) I will send the POC kickoff agenda and quickstart steps (attached). Rafael will own the infra check if you want a private VPC later.
3) You’ll provide a small sample of API traffic patterns and an eval prompt set (we can anonymize).

Attachments: poc-kickoff-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

If those dates work I can put time on the calendar. If you prefer, Rafael and I can also do a hands-on session to walk through the SDK install and a quick inference test.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintech Corp — POC discovery recap & proposed kickoff

Quick follow-up — just wanted to make sure my note and the proposed July 7/8 kickoff hit your inbox. We haven’t received the sample traffic or prompted set yet and want to reserve a sandbox slot for you this month.

If the dates aren’t good, no worries — can you suggest two alternate windows? Happy to run the walkthrough and do the setup with your engineer on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — saw no activity in sandbox, can we help with setup?

Hi Alex / Priya —

Wanted to check in — we noticed the sandbox credentials were issued but there hasn’t been any activity from your side yet. Totally understand priorities shift — I wanted to surface a quick checklist we use to unblock teams and offer a hands-on session if helpful: 

POC quick checklist
- SDK install (node/python) — ~10 minutes
- API key configured and test call made (sample cURL included in quickstart)
- Send 100 sample requests to validate latency and token counts
- Share a minimal eval prompt set (5–10 examples)

We’ve attached the Redwood quickstart guide and I can schedule a 30-minute troubleshooting session this week to jump in and finish the last mile. If the POC is lower priority right now, would appreciate a straight-up status update so we can replan.

Proposed times for a hands-on walkthrough: Mon Jul 13 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed Jul 15 11:00–11:30 PT. Which works for you?

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (application/pdf)

If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume the POC is paused and circle back in two weeks — but happy to accelerate if you can spare 30 minutes.

Best,
Marissa
